svg.aria-label: One tool, instead of many: Install apps: apt, dnf, pacman, Flatpak, Homebrew, or nami install; Pick a version: PPAs, building it yourself, or firefox: 150; Give a project its tools: nvm, pyenv, rbenv, asdf, mise, devbox, direnv, or project.nami; Run a project's database: Docker Compose, or nami up; Try a tool once: npx, pipx run, nix-shell -p, or nami try; Keep your dotfiles: chezmoi, GNU Stow, yadm, or ~/.gitconfig:; Keep secrets in git: sops, agenix, or !secret; Set up every computer alike: setup scripts, Ansible, or nami sync; Ship your app to every distro: AppImage, Snap, a package per distro, or nami bundle

svg.text: Ship your app to every distro
All in the same few YAML files, and every change can be undone.
